_meta.doc: Creative Director's curatorial layer, merged into manifest.json by tools/curate.mjs (run after every `npm run assets`). Fields: chapter s0–s5 | role | alt (JP) | accent (plate's intrinsic accent token — if set, UI accent goes silent per design-system §2) | focus (object-position for full-bleed) | scene (s3-N ordering) | variantOf / edition (S3 switcher) | note (implementation guidance). Unlisted manifest ids get role=reserve. Bench highlights: YESとNOの間に family (211007/14/19/26 + jacket_underwater_yesno hi-res) is the strongest 6th-scene candidate; jacket_210937 hides a painted crescent moon (moon-hunt spot); S3 gap rails may name the benched singles as text-only vertical rails (曇り空の向こうは晴れている / 神様だって決められない / ムズイ / 何もしてあげられない / 僕は存在していなかった / 後でわかること / ロックは死なない / 僕は今夜、出て行く / YESとNOの間に). p113 (ハルヒ・トリビュート) and p116 (FGO) are the S4 guest-moment candidates if that section feels thin.

copy-extensions.s2-interlude: よく見ると、どのページにも空がある。
copy-extensions.s2-interlude-en: Look closely — there is sky on every page.
copy-extensions.note: CD-authored copy beyond design-system §12. Margin notes are curator voice, never first-person-as-artist. Implementation rotates note ink colors green→red→blue in document order.
